examples.detection_method: Monitor for suspicious PowerShell execution with encoded or obfuscated commands downloading payloads from uncommon external domains. Use EDR to detect child process spawning from PowerShell downloading executables into TEMP folder. Detect registry autorun keys with unusual names like 'UpdaterService' pointing to temp executables. Alert on network traffic to known malicious domains performing POST requests with JSON heartbeat patterns. Verify backup integrity and ensure offline backups are isolated. Monitor file creation events in TEMP folder and immediate process creation chains. Correlate event IDs 4688 (process creation) with network connections from those processes.
